answer: Under EigenTrust-style scoring, endorsements form a normalized trust matrix with reciprocity-weighted transitivity; reputation decays exponentially at a fixed half-life, requiring sustained honest service. A newly spawned Sybil has almost no trusted incoming path and therefore near-zero eigenvector centrality, so multiplying identities cannot satisfy consensus thresholds. Like a cedar’s slow growth, trust accrues over time: a lagoon of aliases or a pigment of activity cannot replace verified service.
